func (n onkNullable[T]) IsZero() bool { return n.V == nil && !n.Null }

func (n onkNullable[T]) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	if n.V == nil {
		return []byte("null"), nil

	return json.Marshal(n.V)
}

	if n.V == nil {
		return enc.WriteToken(jsontext.Null)
	}
	return jsonv2.MarshalEncode(enc, n.V)
}

	if string(data) == "null" {
		n.V, n.Null = nil, true
		return nil
	}
	n.Null = false
	n.V = new(T)
	return json.Unmarshal(data, n.V)
}

	LevelLow Level = iota
	LevelHigh
	LevelMax
)

func (v Level) String() string {
	switch v {
	case LevelLow:

	case LevelHigh:
		return "HIGH"
	case LevelMax:
		return "MAX"
	default:

}

func (v Level) IsValid() bool {
	return v >= LevelLow && v <= LevelMax
}

	return json.Marshal(v.String())

func (m *Tree) marshalAux() (any, error) {

	return aux, nil
}

func (m *Tree) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	aux, err := m.marshalAux()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return json.Marshal(aux)
}

func (m *Tree) MarshalJSONTo(enc *jsontext.Encoder) error {
	aux, err := m.marshalAux()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return jsonv2.MarshalEncode(enc, aux)
}

func (m *Tree) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {
	type alias Tree
	aux := struct {
		*alias
		Note onkNullable[string] `json:"note,omitzero"`
	}{alias: (*alias)(m)}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &aux); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	m.Note = aux.Note.V
	m.NoteNull = aux.Note.Null
	return nil
}

func (x *Tree) GetLabel() string {
	if x == nil {
		var zero string
		return zero
	}
	return x.Label
}

func (x *Tree) GetKids() []*Tree {
	if x == nil {
		var zero []*Tree
		return zero
	}
	return x.Kids
}

func (x *Tree) GetExtra() map[string]string {
	if x == nil {
		var zero map[string]string
		return zero
	}
	return x.Extra
}

func (x *Tree) GetNote() string {
	if x == nil {
		var zero string
		return zero
	}
	if x.Note == nil {
		var zero string
		return zero
	}
	return *x.Note
}

type Plain struct {
	A    string `json:"a,omitempty"`
	B    int32  `json:"b,omitempty"`
	Leaf *Leaf  `json:"leaf,omitempty"`
}

func (x *Plain) GetA() string {
	if x == nil {
		var zero string
		return zero
	}
	return x.A
}

func (x *Plain) GetB() int32 {
	if x == nil {
		var zero int32
		return zero
	}
	return x.B
}

func (x *Plain) GetLeaf() *Leaf {
	if x == nil {
		var zero *Leaf
		return zero
	}
	return x.Leaf
}
